features.name: daily_trade_count
features.endpoint_or_archive: Binance public USD-M monthly klines archive; frozen bars.parquet
features.lag: three bars opened t-24h, t-16h, t-8h; all closed by 00:00 decision t
features.transformation: N_it=sum of three bars; enters ln(N_it)-ln(Q_it)
features.missing_data_behavior: missing unless exactly three bars and N_it>=10; no pseudocount

features.name: daily_quote_volume
features.endpoint_or_archive: Binance public USD-M monthly klines archive; frozen bars.parquet
features.lag: same three completed bars through decision t
features.transformation: Q_it=sum; ln(N_it)-ln(Q_it); prior/current 30-day median supplies liquidity nuisance
features.missing_data_behavior: missing unless exactly three bars and Q_it>=100000 USDT

features.name: fragmentation_shock
features.event_timestamp: 00:00 UTC after all three source bars close
features.lag: current x uses data through t; baseline uses 120 prior valid days excluding t
features.missing_data_behavior: exclude symbol for the decision when current or baseline rule fails; never impute

features.name: close_return_volatility
features.endpoint_or_archive: Binance public USD-M monthly klines archive; frozen bars.parquet
features.lag: daily close return through t; 30-day trailing window including t
features.transformation: sqrt(365)*sample_sd(log(C_t/C_t-1),30), min 20; cross-sectional average rank nuisance
features.missing_data_behavior: exclude symbol when fewer than 20 returns

features.name: btc_beta
features.endpoint_or_archive: Binance public USD-M monthly klines archive; frozen bars.parquet
features.lag: 90 trailing daily returns through t, minimum 60 paired
features.transformation: past-only covariance/variance beta; cross-sectional average rank nuisance
features.missing_data_behavior: exclude symbol if BTC is unavailable, pairs<60, or BTC variance<=0

features.name: pit_eligible_symbols
features.endpoint_or_archive: frozen membership.parquet built from prior-30-complete-day Binance quote volume
features.lag: most recent reconstitution at or before t, intersected with decision-time fillability
features.transformation: eligibility gate only; liquidity rank is not alpha
features.missing_data_behavior: no earlier membership means ineligible; absent decision-time open means ineligible

execution_only_inputs.use: next-open fills, participation cap, and forced exits in common evaluator; open price is hidden from strategy
common cashflow -signed_position_notional*funding_rate; never an alpha feature
common exposure/risk accounting only; never an alpha feature
